methods.name: Reverse
methods.header:
method Reverse(s: seq<int>) returns (r: seq<int>)
  ensures |r| == |s|
  ensures forall k :: 0 <= k < |s| ==> r[k] == s[|s| - 1 - k]

mutants.violation: Two distinct semantic defects: forward traversal copies input order instead of reversing it; starting at index one omits the first input element

defects.description: forward traversal copies input order instead of reversing it
defects.independent_repair_note: Repairing the start index alone yields [1,2,3], still violating R2.

defects.description: starting at index one omits the first input element

representations.natural: [R1] The result sequence r has the same length as s, including when s is empty. [R2] For every valid input index k, r[k] equals s[length(s) - 1 - k].
